mission.title: Kaayyoo Keenya
mission.description: Lafeessa lojistikii Itoophiyaa marsaa dijitaalaa sirriitti walitti hidhuu abdii qabu uumuun abbootii fe'aa fi konkolaachistoota walitti hidhuun konveyaansii gorfachaa, ifaa fi hunda danda'ama godhuu.

vision.title: Mul'ata Keenya

story.title: Seenaa Keenya
story.description: Ethiochinet miira salphaa irraa dhalate: lafeessa lojistikii Itoophiyaa faffacaa'a, hin hojjetne, ifummaa dhabeessa ture. Bara 2023, gareen bu'uraa keenya qarqara kana guutuuf tokkoomte.
